mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI growth and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past two quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods following a GDP decline, or GDP decline does not significantly predict negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals supply-side disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market and high interest rates signal a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not significantly predict negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in the past month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 2% in the past month, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and RSAFS declines > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not significantly predict negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).
